name: Mics 5524 → Request Calibration
description: Capture a new clean-air reference at run time on the component with the given ID. The calibration starts once the warm-up window has passed and uses the `calibration:` parameters (their defaults when no `calibration:` block is set). The result replaces the reference in use. It is stored in flash and survives a reboot only when a `calibration:` block is set and `calibration.persist:` is `true`; without a `calibration:` block it is kept until the next reboot.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the `mics_5524` sensor to calibrate.
